schema.label: Registration
schema.text: Newly diagnosed, early-stage, asymptomatic, high-risk CLL/SLL (CLL-IPI 4 or higher and/or complex cytogenetics) not meeting 2018 iwCLL treatment indications.

schema.label: Stratification
schema.text: High risk (CLL-IPI 4-6) vs very high risk (CLL-IPI 7 or higher, or complex cytogenetics). Dynamic allocation.

arms.label: Arm 1: Delayed V-O
arms.text: Observation (visits every 3 months for the first year, then every 6 months) until a 2018 iwCLL treatment indication is met, then venetoclax plus obinutuzumab as below.

arms.label: Arm 2: Early V-O
arms.text: Venetoclax plus obinutuzumab starting after randomization (planned within 14 calendar days of registration).

schema.label: V-O regimen (both arms)
schema.text: 28-day cycles. Obinutuzumab IV: Cycle 1 100 mg day 1, 900 mg day 2, 1000 mg days 8 and 15; 1000 mg day 1 of Cycles 2-6, then stop. Venetoclax PO with 5-week ramp-up: 20 mg days 22-28 of Cycle 1, then 50, 100, 200, 400 mg weekly in Cycle 2, then 400 mg daily through Cycle 12, then stop. TLS risk assessment and prophylaxis required.

schema.label: Follow-up
schema.text: Until death or 10 years after registration, whichever comes first.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Overall survival.

eligibility: Confirmed CLL or SLL by 2018 iwCLL criteria, diagnosed within 18 months before registration.
CLL-IPI score of 4 or higher and/or complex cytogenetics (3 or more chromosomal abnormalities).

Cytogenetics and/or FISH (at minimum 13q, 12, 11q, 17p probes) in a CLIA-approved or Accreditation Canada laboratory within 18 months before registration; TP53 mutation analysis, if done, within 18 months; IGHV mutation status any time before registration; serum beta-2 microglobulin within 28 days.
Does not meet any iwCLL criterion for active CLL therapy.

No prior CLL-directed therapy of any kind, including immunotherapy, experimental therapy, or radiotherapy; no prior anti-CD20 antibody; no other investigational agents planned before completing protocol therapy.

High-dose corticosteroids or IVIG for autoimmune complications of CLL completed at least 4 weeks before enrollment; steroids for other conditions no more than prednisone 20 mg/day (or equivalent) at registration.
Age 18 or older; ECOG performance status 0-2; able to take oral medication.

Within 28 days: platelets at least 100,000/mm3, ANC at least 1,000/mm3, creatinine clearance at least 30 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault), AST and ALT below 3.0 x ULN, total bilirubin up to 2.0 x ULN (5.0 x ULN with Gilbert's).

No prior malignancy requiring active treatment within 2 years (hormonal therapy allowed); exceptions include non-melanoma skin cancer, cervical carcinoma in situ, superficial bladder cancer without intravesical therapy within 6 months, localized prostate cancer treated with surgery and/or radiation only or on chronic hormonal therapy, Gleason 6 or lower prostate cancer, and localized breast cancer treated with surgery and/or radiation only or on chronic hormonal therapy.

No uncontrolled active hepatitis B or C (detectable HBV DNA or HCV RNA). Latent hepatitis B requires antiviral prophylaxis during and for 6 months after V-O. HIV allowed if on effective antiretroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months.
No cirrhosis and no clinically significant GI malabsorption.
No major surgery within 30 days or minor surgery within 7 days before registration (diagnostic bone marrow biopsy allowed).
No known bleeding disorder; no stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months.
No ongoing need for a strong CYP3A4/5 inhibitor or inducer.
No uncontrolled autoimmune hemolytic anemia or ITP.
No active clinically significant cardiovascular disease (for example uncontrolled arrhythmia or NYHA class 3-4 heart failure); no MI, unstable angina, or acute coronary syndrome within 6 months.
Not pregnant and not nursing.
Must agree to MRD specimen submission.

schema.label: Step 1: Registration
schema.text: Newly diagnosed metastatic RCC with primary tumor in place. Enter either immunotherapy-naive (start pre-randomization treatment within 7 days) or after completing the protocol-specified pre-randomization regimen off protocol (Step 1 and Step 2 the same day).

schema.label: Pre-randomization immunotherapy (choose one, about 12 weeks)
schema.text: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg q3 weeks (up to 4 doses), then nivolumab 240 mg q2 weeks or 480 mg q4 weeks; nivolumab (240 mg q2 weeks or 480 mg q4 weeks) plus cabozantinib 40 mg daily; pembrolizumab (200 mg q3 weeks or 400 mg q6 weeks) plus axitinib 5 mg BID; pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib 20 mg daily; or avelumab (800 mg or 10 mg/kg q2 weeks) plus axitinib 5 mg BID.

schema.label: Week 12 assessment
schema.text: Disease assessment at 12 weeks (plus or minus 2 weeks). Participants without progression (stable disease, partial response, or investigator-judged clinical benefit; suspected pseudoprogression allowed) proceed to randomization; those not randomized are not followed.

schema.label: Stratification at Step 2
schema.text: Zubrod 0 vs 1; immunotherapy combination vs TKI plus immunotherapy; week 12 response PR vs less than PR.

schema.label: Step 2: Randomization 1:1
schema.text: Between week 11 day 1 and week 14 day 7 of pre-randomization treatment.

arms.label: Arm 1
arms.text: Continued systemic immunotherapy-based regimen (same combination as pre-randomization) until progression.

arms.label: Arm 2
arms.text: Cytoreductive nephrectomy (radical or partial; laparoscopic, open, or robotic) planned within 42 days of randomization (no later than 56 days) at an NCTN site, plus continued systemic immunotherapy; systemic therapy may be held up to 42 days perioperatively, axitinib stopped at least 24 hours before surgery.

schema.label: Follow-up
schema.text: Randomized participants followed until death or 7 years after randomization.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Overall survival.

eligibility: Step 1: Histologically proven clear cell or non-clear cell RCC (collecting duct carcinoma excluded; multifocal or bilateral tumors allowed), with primary tumor in place.

Step 1: Measurable or non-measurable metastatic disease on CT chest and CT (with contrast) or MRI abdomen/pelvis within 90 days before registration (immunotherapy-naive) or within 90 days before the first immunotherapy dose (pre-randomization completed).
Step 1: Brain metastases allowed if any post-treatment imaging shows no progression after CNS-directed therapy; brain imaging not required unless clinically indicated.

Step 1: No prior systemic immunotherapy for metastatic RCC beyond the single protocol-specified pre-randomization regimen (if given off protocol), and no immunotherapy for any cancer within 6 months before registration or before starting the pre-randomization regimen. Pre-randomization completed participants must not exceed regimen-specific maximum dose counts (for example 4 ipilimumab infusions, 5 pembrolizumab 200 mg infusions).
Step 1: Palliative radiotherapy for symptomatic metastases is allowed before or after registration.
Step 1: Age 18 or older; no clear contraindication to nephrectomy or immune-based combination therapy; no solitary or transplanted kidney.

No other prior malignancy except adequately treated basal or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ (Step 1 also T1) cancer, adequately treated stage I or II cancer in complete remission, or other cancer disease-free for at least 2 years.

Step 2: Restaging CT chest and CT or MRI abdomen/pelvis 12 weeks (plus or minus 2 weeks) after starting pre-randomization therapy and within 28 days before randomization, showing stable disease, partial response, or investigator-judged clinical benefit with Zubrod 0-1. Complete response in all metastatic sites is not eligible.
Step 2: No progression in metastatic sites or primary tumor (pseudoprogression allowed); plans to continue the same immune-based regimen.

Step 2: Randomized between week 11 day 1 and week 14 day 7 of pre-randomization treatment, after at least the minimum immunotherapy (for example 2 nivolumab plus 1 ipilimumab infusion, 2 pembrolizumab 200 mg or 1 pembrolizumab 400 mg, or 2 avelumab infusions).
Step 2: Urology consultation within 42 days confirming surgical candidacy, with planned surgery date within 42 days of randomization.
Step 2: Zubrod performance status 0-1 and history and physical within 28 days before randomization.
Step 2: Within 28 days: total bilirubin up to 2 x ULN; AST and ALT up to 3 x ULN (up to 5 x ULN with liver metastases); serum creatinine up to 1.5 x ULN or creatinine clearance at least 50 mL/min.

schema.label: Stratification
schema.text: Prior rituximab (yes vs no). Dynamic allocation.

schema.label: Step 1: Randomization
schema.text: 41 eligible participants per arm. Treatment starts within 14 calendar days of registration. 28-day cycles for 24 cycles.

arms.label: Arm 1 (BTK inhibitor)
arms.text: Ibrutinib 420 mg PO daily, Cycles 1-24, plus rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV days 1, 8, 15, 22 of Cycles 2 and 5; or zanubrutinib alone 320 mg PO daily (or 160 mg BID), Cycles 1-24.

arms.label: Arm 2 (BCL-2 inhibitor)
arms.text: Venetoclax 400 mg PO days 1-8, then 800 mg days 9-28 of Cycle 1, then 800 mg daily Cycles 2-24, plus rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV days 1, 8, 15, 22 of Cycles 2 and 5. Allopurinol 300 mg daily from 48-72 hours before Cycle 1 through Cycle 2; TLS labs weekly in Cycle 1.

schema.label: Step 2: Crossover
schema.text: Confirmed progression at any time during Cycles 3-24: cross over to the other arm for 24 cycles. Stable disease or better at the end of 24 cycles: off protocol treatment.

schema.label: Follow-up
schema.text: Up to 5 years from Step 1 registration.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Rate of very good partial response or better.

eligibility: Step 1: Confirmed Waldenström macroglobulinemia/lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with measurable disease (serum IgM spike at least 500 mg/dL); extramedullary disease not required. Baseline disease testing within 28 days before registration.

Step 1: At least one indication for therapy: anemia, thrombocytopenia, WM-related neuropathy, symptomatic hyperviscosity or serum viscosity at least 4.0 cP, WM-associated glomerulonephritis or renal disease, bulky disease, or constitutional symptoms. Smoldering WM is not eligible.
Step 1: No prior systemic therapy; prior rituximab allowed if the last dose was at least 6 months before registration. Not intolerant to rituximab.
Step 1: No ongoing need for (or use within 7 days of first dose of) a moderate or strong CYP3A inducer or inhibitor or a P-gp inhibitor, unless safely switched.
Step 1: Age 18 or older; Zubrod performance status 0-2; history and physical within 28 days.

Step 1: Within 14 days: creatinine clearance at least 30 mL/min; total bilirubin up to 1.5 x ULN; AST, ALT, and alkaline phosphatase up to 3 x ULN; platelets at least 50,000/mm3, hemoglobin at least 7.0 g/dL, ANC at least 1,000/mm3 (transfusion or growth factor allowed up to 7 days before registration).
Step 1: Able to swallow capsules whole; no GI disease or impairment that would significantly alter absorption.
Step 1: No known active infection, and no infection requiring IV antibiotics or hospitalization within 4 weeks before registration.
Step 1: Known HIV allowed if on effective antiretroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months. Not hepatitis C seropositive unless sustained virologic response.
Step 1: No grapefruit, Seville oranges, or starfruit within 3 days before the first venetoclax dose.

Step 1: No other prior malignancy except adequately treated basal or squamous cell skin cancer, cervical carcinoma in situ, adequately treated stage I or II cancer in complete remission, cancer disease-free for 2 years or suitable for watchful waiting, or malignancy considered cured with minimal recurrence risk within 5 years.
Step 1: Not pregnant and not nursing.

Step 2 (crossover): Progression during Cycles 3-24 on the assigned arm; no transformation to intermediate- or high-grade lymphoma and no Bing-Neel syndrome; Zubrod 0-2; within 14 days, creatinine clearance at least 30 mL/min, no marked hepatic dysfunction, platelets at least 50,000/mm3, hemoglobin at least 7.0 g/dL, ANC at least 1,000/mm3.

schema.label: Registration
schema.text: Advanced or metastatic poorly differentiated extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma. Treatment starts within 7 calendar days of registration.

schema.label: Stratification
schema.text: Zubrod 0-1 vs 2; tumor origin: prostate vs GI vs other (non-prostate, non-GI, or unknown).

schema.label: Randomize 1:1:1
schema.text: Induction is 4 cycles of 21 days. Platinum is physician's choice: carboplatin AUC 5 or cisplatin 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, with etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1-3. A single pre-registration cycle of platinum/etoposide does not count toward the 4.

arms.label: Arm 1 (experimental)
arms.text: Atezolizumab 1,200 mg IV day 1 plus platinum/etoposide for 4 cycles; if no progression, maintenance atezolizumab 1,200 mg IV every 21 days for up to 17 cycles (maximum 1 year).

arms.label: Arm 2 (experimental, closed)
arms.text: Atezolizumab plus platinum/etoposide for 4 cycles, then observation for 1 year. Permanently closed to accrual effective July 9, 2026; new participants are randomized to Arm 1 or Arm 3 only.

arms.label: Arm 3 (control)
arms.text: Platinum/etoposide for 4 cycles, then observation for 1 year.

schema.label: Follow-up
schema.text: Until death or 5 years after registration, whichever comes first.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Overall survival from randomization, tested in fixed sequence: Arm 1 vs Arm 3, then Arm 2 vs Arm 3, then Arm 1 vs Arm 2.

eligibility: Histologically confirmed extrapulmonary poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma by WHO criteria, with Ki-67 of 55% or higher (Ki-67 not required for genitourinary origin); local pathology confirmation is sufficient.

Unresectable or metastatic disease not eligible for definitive therapy, with RECIST-evaluable (measurable or non-measurable) disease on contrast CT chest/abdomen/pelvis (or CT chest plus MRI abdomen/pelvis) within 28 days before registration. PET or bone scan alone is not acceptable.

Brain MRI (or contrast head CT) within 28 days only if clinically indicated. No symptomatic CNS metastases and no known or suspected leptomeningeal disease. Treated brain metastases need no progression within 28 days and steroids stopped at least 14 days; untreated lesions must be 2.0 cm or smaller, without mass effect, edema, or progression, and need no more than dexamethasone 2 mg/day (or prednisone 10 mg).

No prior therapy for advanced or metastatic NEC except one cycle of platinum plus etoposide. Prior platinum-based therapy with or without radiation or surgery for localized or locally advanced NEC allowed if completed at least 6 months before registration. Prostate or urothelial NEC: prior chemotherapy for the non-NEC component allowed if completed at least 24 weeks before registration.

No prior immune checkpoint inhibitor (anti-PD-1, PD-L1, PD-L2, CTLA-4, CD137 agonist, or other) for any neuroendocrine neoplasm; checkpoint inhibitors for other cancers allowed if the last dose was at least 12 months before registration. No systemic immunostimulatory agents (interferon, IL-2) within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives.

No active systemic therapy for another cancer except hormonal therapy (ADT may continue; enzalutamide or apalutamide only after chemotherapy; darolutamide allowed during chemotherapy; no abiraterone or other glucocorticoid-containing regimens). Denosumab must be stopped and replaced with a bisphosphonate.
Age 18 or older; Zubrod performance status 0-2 within 28 days.

Within 14 days (at least 21 days after day 1 of any pre-registration chemotherapy cycle): ANC at least 1.5 x 10^9/L, hemoglobin at least 9.0 g/dL, platelets at least 100 x 10^9/L, AST and ALT up to 2.5 x ULN, total bilirubin up to 1.5 x ULN, creatinine clearance above 50 mL/min. No uncontrolled or symptomatic hypercalcemia.
No immunodeficiency and no systemic steroids above hydrocortisone 20 mg/day equivalent or other immunosuppression within 14 days.
No active or prior autoimmune disease, except hypothyroidism on replacement, controlled type 1 diabetes on insulin, and limited skin-only eczema, psoriasis, lichen simplex chronicus, or vitiligo.

No idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, organizing pneumonia, drug-induced or idiopathic pneumonitis, or active pneumonitis on screening CT (radiation pneumonitis confined to the radiation field is allowed).
No NYHA class II or higher heart disease, MI within 3 months, unstable arrhythmia, or unstable angina.
No major surgery (other than diagnostic) within 28 days or planned during treatment. No grade 2 or higher infection at registration and no known active tuberculosis.
Chronic HBV requires undetectable viral load; HCV must be cured or undetectable on treatment; known HIV requires effective antiretroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months.
No prior allogeneic stem cell or solid organ transplant. No live attenuated vaccine within 28 days before treatment, during atezolizumab, or for 5 months after.
No severe hypersensitivity to chimeric or humanized antibodies, CHO cell products, atezolizumab, cisplatin, carboplatin, or etoposide.
Not pregnant.

schema.label: Design
schema.text: Prospective observational cohort study. No protocol treatment: participants start standard-of-care immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy chosen by their physician. Limited to NCORP and MU-NCORP community sites since Revision #6.

schema.label: Cohorts
schema.text: Cohort 1: ICI alone (closed 05/06/2024). Cohort 2: chemotherapy plus ICI for SCLC or NSCLC, gastroesophageal cancer, or triple-negative breast cancer on listed regimens, in the advanced or neoadjuvant setting, given per NCCN Category 1 or 2A and not on a clinical trial.

schema.label: Registration
schema.text: Consent, baseline assessments and PROs, then start ICI within 7 days of registration.

schema.label: Evaluations
schema.text: Weeks 4, 12, 24, and 52 after starting ICI, plus an evaluation at any grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event (irAE). Participation ends after the week 52 evaluation.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Develop and validate risk models for grade 3 or higher non-hematologic irAEs within the first year of ICI therapy.

eligibility: Planned to start standard-of-care ICI (Cohort 1) or chemotherapy plus ICI on a listed regimen for an eligible tumor type (Cohort 2) within 7 days after registration; not on a clinical trial for this treatment.
Prior ICI allowed only if completed at least 180 days before registration and not discontinued for an irAE.
No chemotherapy, biologic, or targeted therapy within 14 days before registration; hormonal therapy allowed.
Cohort 2: no planned targeted or non-ICI biologic therapy with the chemotherapy plus ICI regimen.
Recovered from prior treatment toxicity to grade 1 or less non-hematologic (grade 2 or less for neuropathy and alopecia) and grade 3 or less hematologic.
Palliative radiotherapy, growth factors, and osteoclast inhibitors allowed.
Age 18 or older; history and physical within 28 days before registration.
Able to complete PRO questionnaires in English, Spanish, or French; baseline PROs completed within 14 days before registration.

schema.label: Design
schema.text: Single-arm phase II immunoMATCH pilot (BiCaZO) of cabozantinib plus nivolumab in PD-1 refractory melanoma or HNSCC. Two disease cohorts (melanoma, HNSCC), each stratified by tumor inflammation score (TIS): TIS high is 6 or more for melanoma and 7 or more for HNSCC. TMB is measured but no longer used for cohort assignment.

schema.label: Step 1: Specimen submission
schema.text: Order kits one week before registration. Submit fresh biopsy or archival tissue plus blood within 3 days after Step 1 registration for central TMB and TIS testing.

schema.label: Step 2: Treatment registration
schema.text: Stage I: registered and treated before biomarker results, assigned to biomarker cohort retrospectively. Stage II (opened with Revision #5): registered only if a slot is open in the participant's biomarker cohort; otherwise off study. Treatment starts within 7 days of Step 2 registration.

schema.label: Treatment
schema.text: Nivolumab 480 mg IV day 1 every 28 days plus cabozantinib 40 mg PO daily, fasting (no food 2 hours before and 1 hour after). Up to 24 months or 26 cycles. Treatment beyond initial RECIST progression allowed during the first 24 weeks if clinically stable and benefiting.

schema.label: Follow-up
schema.text: Until death or 3 years after Step 2 registration.

schema.label: Accrual
schema.text: Through September 30, 2027 or until 220 participants are screened, whichever comes first.

schema.label: Primary endpoints
schema.text: Feasibility: proportion with biomarker turnaround of 21 days or less (Stage I TMB; Stage II TMB and TIS), with at least 75% considered feasible. Efficacy: ORR in each disease cohort by TIS subgroup.

eligibility: Step 1: Histologically confirmed unresectable stage III or IV, recurrent, or metastatic non-uveal melanoma; or HNSCC of the oropharynx, oral cavity, hypopharynx, or larynx that is metastatic or locally recurrent and not amenable to curative therapy. No nasopharynx primary or unknown primary. HPV or p16 status known for oropharynx.
Step 1: Disease consistent with measurable disease.

Step 1: Documented progression during or within 12 weeks after the last dose of PD-1 based therapy, after at least 6 weeks of checkpoint inhibitor. Recurrence during or within 12 weeks of adjuvant anti-PD-1 qualifies if measurable and unresectable.
Step 1: Recovered to baseline or grade 1 or less from prior treatment toxicity (unless clinically nonsignificant or stable on supportive therapy).

Step 1: No more than one prior curative or adjuvant RT course to head and neck mucosal surfaces, completed at least 16 weeks before (chemoradiation) or 8 weeks before (RT alone). Palliative RT allowed if not to previously irradiated tissue (CNS excepted) and finished at least 4 weeks before. Treated areas healed with no RT sequelae predisposing to fistula.
Step 1: No prior anti-VEGF therapy.
Step 1: Age 18 or older; Zubrod 0-1; NYHA class 2B or better if cardiac history or prior cardiotoxic therapy; able to swallow capsules whole; no malabsorption.
Step 1: No MI or thromboembolic event requiring anticoagulation within 90 days unless stable on management. No uncontrolled hypertension (systolic over 150 or diastolic over 90 mmHg) within 28 days.

Step 1: No hemoptysis (1/2 teaspoon or more of bright red blood) or tumor bleeding within 90 days. No prior carotid bleeding, tumor invading major vessels, cavitary central lung metastases (within 2 cm of hilum), or bleeding from the current head and neck cancer.

Step 1: No warfarin, direct thrombin inhibitors, betrixaban, or platelet inhibitors such as clopidogrel. Low-dose aspirin and prophylactic LMWH allowed; therapeutic LMWH, rivaroxaban, edoxaban, or apixaban allowed if no known brain metastases and stable dose for at least 1 week.

Step 1: No active autoimmune disease requiring more than 10 mg prednisone equivalent or other immunosuppression (type 1 diabetes, replaced endocrinopathy, and non-systemically treated skin disorders allowed). No organ allograft. No active infection requiring systemic therapy.

Step 1: HIV allowed with undetectable viral load within 6 months on ART. Chronic HBV allowed with undetectable viral load within 28 days; prior HCV allowed with undetectable viral load within 28 days.
Step 1: Adequate archival tissue obtained after resistance to anti-PD-1/L1, or fresh biopsy with under 2% expected risk of severe complications; whole blood for germline analysis.
Step 1: Not pregnant and not nursing.
Step 2: Still meets Step 1 criteria; tissue submitted; Stage II participants assigned to an open cohort.
Step 2: Measurable disease assessed within 28 days (non-measurable within 42 days). Melanoma: CT chest, abdomen, and pelvis. HNSCC: CT neck and chest.
Step 2: Treated brain metastases without progression after CNS-directed therapy and off steroids at least 14 days.

Step 2: No surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, biologic agents, or steroids within 14 days; no investigational agents or monoclonal antibodies within 28 days; no live vaccine within 30 days; no strong CYP3A4 inducers within 14 days or strong inhibitors within 5 half-lives.

Step 2: H&P within 28 days. Within 28 days: leukocytes at least 3,000/uL, ANC at least 1,500/uL, platelets at least 100,000/uL, total bilirubin up to 1.5 x ULN (3 x ULN with Gilbert's), AST and ALT up to 3 x ULN, creatinine clearance at least 30 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault), baseline urinalysis.

amendments.text: Revision #7: Stage II accrual extended through September 30, 2027 or 220 screened; cohorts simplified to TIS high or low within melanoma and HNSCC (TMB no longer used for assignment); TIS replaces GEP throughout; ORR analyzed by TIS subgroup with new secondary objectives for ORR by TIS and TMB and TMB as a continuous variable; Stage II futility analysis consolidated across cohorts; CD8 and PD-L1 translational analysis added.

reviewed.notes: Calendar column placement for the on-treatment blood draws was confirmed against the nivolumab row (Cycles 1, 2, and 4). Final analysis is planned at 120 accrued participants (per the design table); no fixed per-cohort sample size given the accrual cap.

schema.text: Resected (R0 or R1) high-risk well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, resected 14-120 days before registration

schema.label: Stratification
schema.text: Metastatic (resected/ablated liver oligometastases) vs non-metastatic; Recurrence Risk Score (Zaidi) >= 6 vs < 6

schema.label: Randomize 2:1
schema.text: Dynamic balancing; treatment starts within 15 days of registration

arms.label: Arm 1: CAPTEM
arms.text: Capecitabine 750 mg/m2 PO twice daily days 1-14 plus temozolomide 200 mg/m2 PO once daily days 10-14 (capped at 400 mg/day), 28-day cycles x 4

arms.label: Arm 2: Observation
arms.text: Surveillance, no adjuvant therapy

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Recurrence-free survival

eligibility: Age >= 18; Zubrod performance status 0-2.
Histologically confirmed well-differentiated pancreatic NET resected 14-120 days before registration, with R0 or R1 resection.
Ki-67 from the surgical specimen >= 3% and <= 55% (use the highest value if more than one is reported).

Localized disease must have a Recurrence Risk Score (Zaidi) >= 3: symptomatic tumor (GI bleed, jaundice, obstruction, pain, pancreatitis) 1 point; primary >= 2 cm 2 points; Ki-67 3-20% 1 point or 21-55% 6 points; node positive 1 point. Score is not required for resected liver-only metastatic disease.
Resection or ablation of up to 5 liver oligometastases at the time of pNET resection is allowed; no unresected or unablated metastatic disease.
Multiphase CT or contrast MRI of the abdomen within 90 days before registration showing no metastatic disease (other than resected/ablated liver oligometastases).
No clinically apparent CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
No prior neoadjuvant therapy for pNET (preoperative somatostatin analogs allowed).
No postoperative somatostatin analogs for tumor control; a short course for surgical complications (e.g., fistula prevention) is allowed if stopped by registration.
Recovered from surgery.

Within 28 days: WBC >= 3,000/uL, ANC >= 1,500/uL, platelets >= 100,000/uL, total bilirubin <= ULN (<= 5 x ULN with Gilbert's), AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, creatinine <= 1.5 x ULN and calculated CrCl >= 50 mL/min.
Able to swallow pills; no known absorption problems; no allergy to temozolomide or capecitabine analogs.
No planned warfarin during protocol treatment (other anticoagulants allowed).
No arterial thromboembolic event, unstable angina, or MI within 90 days before registration.
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
No active or uncontrolled infection; no serious medical or psychiatric illness affecting participation.
Not pregnant.

eligibility: Step 1: Age >= 18; Zubrod performance status 0-2.

Step 1: Histologically confirmed DLBCL (WHO subtypes including HGBL with MYC and BCL2/BCL6 rearrangement), PMBCL, or FL grade 3B; transformed DLBCL only from follicular or marginal zone lymphoma. No history of CLL/SLL, Richter's transformation, or mantle cell lymphoma.
Step 1: Bidimensionally measurable disease (at least one lesion > 1.5 cm); secondary CNS lymphoma allowed only if asymptomatic.

Step 1: Candidate for FDA-approved commercial CD19 CAR T per package insert; registered after leukapheresis consent and before lymphodepletion; LD chemo within 60 days of registration; no prior CAR T.

Step 1: Bridging therapy (chemotherapy, radiation, steroids, novel agents) allowed, with PET-CT after bridging; CR after bridging makes the patient ineligible for Step 2. Mosunetuzumab not allowed as bridging; progression on bridging polatuzumab or a CD20 bispecific is exclusionary.
Step 1: Prior polatuzumab or mosunetuzumab allowed if not refractory and no relapse within 6 months of the last dose.

Step 1: Within 14 days: bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN (unless Gilbert's or liver lymphoma), AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, CrCl >= 40 mL/min. LVEF >= 40% by ECHO or MUGA within 60 days; NYHA class 2B or better if symptomatic.
Step 1: No MI with PCI within 6 months, MI without PCI within 3 months, or unstable angina; no peripheral neuropathy affecting ADLs; no serious intracranial hemorrhage or edema within 6 months.
Step 1: HBV requires undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy; HCV requires completed eradication and undetectable load; HIV requires effective ART with undetectable load within 6 months.

Step 1: No active GVHD (except grade 1 skin on topical therapy); no autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy in the last 2 years; no interfering prior or concurrent malignancy; not pregnant or nursing.
Step 2: Commercial-specification product (no EAP or single-patient IND) infused 2-14 days after LD chemo; day 25-40 PET-CT read centrally as SD or PR; randomized no later than 60 days after infusion.
Step 2: No radiation or chemotherapy since CAR T infusion and no planned radiation after randomization; no active CNS lymphoma.

Step 2: Within 7 days: ANC >= 1,000/uL (no myeloid growth factor within 72 hours), platelets >= 75,000/uL (no transfusion within 72 hours), bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN, AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, CrCl >= 40 mL/min.
Step 2: No CRS or ICANS within 7 days (steroid taper <= 10 mg prednisone equivalent allowed); no uncontrolled infection, chronic active EBV, HLH, or PML history.

Step 3 (crossover): Arm 4 progression within 12 months of CAR T, registered within 28 days of progression, no lymphoma-directed therapy (systemic or radiation) after progression; Step 2 organ-function thresholds within 14 days.

eligibility: Age >= 18; body weight > 30 kg; Zubrod performance status 0-2.
Histologically confirmed ER- and/or PR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer per ASCO/CAP (HER2-low or equivocal allowed if no HER2-directed therapy).
Clinical stage II or III, including inflammatory breast cancer; no occult primary with axillary nodes only.
No metastatic disease (cM0 or Mx); no locally recurrent breast cancer.
Multifocal or synchronous bilateral tumors allowed if all biopsied tumors are HR+/HER2- and at least one is MammaPrint High 2.
At least 10 unstained FFPE slides from the diagnostic biopsy for MammaPrint, or a known MP2 result from the last 12 weeks (any known non-MP2 result is ineligible).
Step 2: MammaPrint High 2 (index -1.0 to -0.57 inclusive).
No prior treatment for this breast cancer (chemotherapy, immunotherapy, biologic, or hormonal) and a candidate for doxorubicin, paclitaxel, and durvalumab.
No non-infectious pneumonitis requiring steroids or active pneumonitis within 2 years; no autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy within 2 years (replacement therapy allowed).
No live vaccine within 28 days before randomization.
Within 28 days of Step 2: WBC >= 3,000/uL, ANC >= 1,500/uL, platelets >= 100,000/uL, total bilirubin <= ULN (<= 5 x ULN with Gilbert's), AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, CrCl >= 50 mL/min.
NYHA class 2B or better if cardiac history, symptoms, or prior cardiotoxic therapy.
No uncontrolled diabetes (HbA1c >= 9.0% within 28 days).
HIV on effective ART with undetectable viral load, chronic HBV with undetectable load on suppression, and HCV treated and cured or undetectable, each within 6 months.
Prior or concurrent malignancy allowed only if it will not interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant or nursing.

Biopsy-proven systemic AL amyloidosis (Congo red with green birefringence or characteristic EM) with confirmatory typing by mass spectrometry or immunofluorescence.

Measurable disease (monoclonal serum or urine immunofixation or clonal marrow plasma cells) plus dFLC >= 2 mg/dL, assessed within 28 days before therapy (56 days if treatment started before registration).
Up to one cycle (28 days) of any plasma cell-directed therapy before enrollment; no MOD-PFS event if prior Dara-VCD counts toward induction.

Transplant eligible for melphalan 140-200 mg/m2 and willing to undergo ASCT: supine SBP >= 90 mmHg; NT-proBNP < 5000 pg/mL (or BNP < 400); cTnT < 0.06 ng/mL (or hsTnT < 75 ng/L or TnI < 0.1 ng/mL); NYHA I-II; LVEF >= 40%.

Within 56 days: Hb > 8.0 g/dL, WBC >= 2,000/uL, ANC >= 1,000/uL, platelets >= 50,000/uL, bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN, direct bilirubin <= 2.0 mg/dL, AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, alkaline phosphatase <= 750 U/L (hepatic involvement excepted), creatinine <= ULN or CrCl >= 30 mL/min.
Peripheral neuropathy grade <= 2.
No concurrent multiple myeloma (lytic lesions, plasmacytoma, >= 60% marrow plasma cells, or hypercalcemia).
No HBsAg positivity or detectable HBV DNA; HCV treated and cured or undetectable within 6 months; HIV on ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months.
No COPD with FEV1 < 50% predicted; no moderate or severe persistent asthma within 2 years or uncontrolled asthma.
No uncontrolled diabetes, hypertension, or infection; no major surgery within 14 days; no live vaccine within 28 days.
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant or nursing.

Step 2: At least PR after 3 cycles, no MOD-PFS event, still receiving daratumumab plus at least one other study drug; cardiac criteria rechecked within 14 days and labs within 28 days; ASCT arm must collect >= 2.0 x 10^6 CD34+/kg.

HIV on effective ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months; chronic HBV with undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy within 6 months; HCV treated and cured, or undetectable viral load within 6 months if on treatment.

No inflammatory bowel disease, symptomatic autoimmune disease, or CNS or motor neuropathy of autoimmune origin (Graves' disease allowed); no pneumonitis requiring oral or IV steroids within 12 months.
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant or nursing.

eligibility: Age >= 18; Zubrod performance status 0-2.

Histologically confirmed classic follicular lymphoma (formerly grade 1-3A); FL with uncommon features, including diffuse growth pattern, eligible. No blastoid or large centrocyte features and no follicular large B-cell lymphoma (formerly grade 3B).

Low tumor burden: no mass >= 7 cm, no more than 3 nodal or extranodal sites > 3 cm, no B symptoms, no symptomatic splenomegaly, no compression syndrome, no lymphoma-related pleural or peritoneal effusion.
Ann Arbor stage II-IV; stage I allowed if the participant declines or is not a candidate for radiation.
Distress from disease or preference for active management over watch and wait.
Staging within 49 days (PET-CT preferred; otherwise CT chest/abdomen/pelvis plus bone marrow biopsy); bidimensionally measurable disease (at least one lesion > 1.5 cm longest diameter).
No prior systemic therapy for follicular lymphoma; prior RT for early-stage follicular lymphoma allowed.
Labs within 28 days: WBC >= 3,000/uL, Hb > 9.0 g/dL, ANC >= 1,500/uL, platelets >= 100,000/uL, bilirubin <= 2 x ULN (<= 5 x ULN with Gilbert's), AST/ALT <= 3 x ULN, CrCl >= 30 mL/min.
No active or uncontrolled infection; no uncontrolled diabetes or blood pressure within 14 days.

HIV on effective ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months; chronic HBV with undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy (core antibody positive, HBsAg negative should receive antiviral prophylaxis); HCV treated and cured, or undetectable viral load within 6 months if on treatment.
No autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy; no organ transplant requiring ongoing immunosuppression; no prior allogeneic stem cell transplant.
No known chronic active EBV infection; no positive COVID-19 test within 7 days.
No history of PML, macrophage activation syndrome, or HLH.
No significant cardiovascular disease (NYHA class III-IV, MI within 6 months, unstable arrhythmia or angina).
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant or nursing.

schema.text: mCRPC previously treated with docetaxel (castrate-sensitive and/or castrate-resistant setting). eligibility: Step 1: Age ≥18 with histologically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma; treatment-related neuroendocrine carcinoma is eligible, de novo treatment-naive small cell prostate cancer is not.
Step 1: Metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer to bone and/or RECIST-measurable soft tissue, visceral, or nodal disease on bone scan and/or CT, PET-CT, or MRI of chest, abdomen, and pelvis.
Step 1: Any prior therapy allowed, but must include docetaxel (castrate-sensitive and/or castrate-resistant setting).

Step 1: FFPE bone or soft tissue biopsy material (blocks or 10 unstained slides) collected within 36 months before Step 1, submitted for central AVPC-MS IHC even if tested locally; metastatic CRPC-state samples preferred.
Step 2: Randomized within 70 days of Step 1 with AVPC-MS result in hand; protocol therapy planned to start within 7 days of randomization (Section 5.2 note says 14).

Step 2: Castrate testosterone <50 ng/dL within 28 days; metastatic disease on bone scan and/or chest/abdomen/pelvis imaging within 28 days (measurable visceral/soft tissue lesions ≥1.0 cm, nodes >1.5 cm short axis).
Step 2: Progressive disease by RECIST 1.1, bone progression (≥2 new bone scan lesions, or new or enlarging lytic lesion on CT/MRI), PCWG2 PSA rise, or unequivocal clinical progression.
Step 2: No prior cabazitaxel or carboplatin, and not on another therapeutic trial.

Step 2 washouts: chemotherapy, radium-223, sipuleucel-T, radioligands (e.g., Lu-177), and trial agents ≥21 days; abiraterone and second-generation antiandrogens >3 days; stereotactic RT ≥3 days; no other RT or kyphoplasty/vertebroplasty within 14 days; no major surgery within 28 days.
Step 2: No untreated fractures or cord compression. No symptomatic uncontrolled brain metastases (brain metastases properly treated, e.g., with stereotactic RT, are allowed).
Step 2: Zubrod PS 0-2 within 28 days.

Step 2 labs within 28 days: ANC ≥1.5 x 10^3/uL; platelets ≥100 x 10^3/uL (>75 x 10^3/uL if marrow infiltration); total bilirubin ≤ULN (Gilbert's, liver metastases, or acute tumor-associated illness <4x ULN); AST/ALT ≤3x ULN (≤4x with liver metastases); Cockcroft-Gault CrCl ≥30 mL/min.
Step 2: Peripheral neuropathy ≤ grade 2.
Step 2: No prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Step 2: HIV allowed if on effective ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months.

Able to safely receive at least one listed SOC regimen, decided before registration; IMDC favorable-risk patients cannot receive ipilimumab plus nivolumab.

No prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic RCC and no prior immune-based combination therapy; prior neoadjuvant/adjuvant anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-CTLA-4 allowed if >12 months before registration.
No systemic antibiotics within 7 days before registration; uncontrolled infections fully resolved. No planned over-the-counter probiotics while on protocol treatment.
No systemic corticosteroids >10 mg/day prednisone equivalent (other than adrenal replacement), and adrenal replacement not >50 mg/day hydrocortisone or prednisone equivalent.
Able to swallow oral medication with no GI disorder likely to impair absorption.

No uncontrolled hypertension (all readings within 28 days SBP ≤140 and DBP ≤90) and no clinically significant uncontrolled cardiovascular disease within 28 days.
No active autoimmune disease that prohibits immune checkpoint therapy.

HIV allowed with effective ART and undetectable viral load within 6 months; chronic HBV allowed with undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy; HCV must be cured or have undetectable viral load on treatment.
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.

Measurable disease by PET/CT or hematopathology (morphology or flow) and staging PET/CT within 42 days before registration.

No major bleeding event or grade ≥3 arrhythmia on prior BTK inhibitor therapy.
No major surgery within 28 days.
Able to swallow oral medication with no GI disorder likely to impair absorption.

HIV allowed with effective ART (no pirtobrutinib interactions) and undetectable viral load within 6 months; chronic HBV allowed with undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy; HCV must be cured or have undetectable viral load on treatment.

Not pregnant and not nursing.

eligibility: Age ≥18, Zubrod PS 0-2.

Histologically diagnosed CD20+ MZL (splenic, nodal, or extranodal) per WHO; excludes GI-only MZL assessable only by endoscopy and cutaneous-only MZL. Repeat biopsy required only after prior CD3/CD20 bispecific (to document CD20+ MZL); splenic MZL needs bone marrow biopsy within 42 days.
Measurable disease by PET-CT (preferred) or CT (extranodal ≥1 cm or nodal ≥1.5 cm); splenic MZL eligible if spleen SUV > liver background and/or spleen >13 cm. Staging imaging within 42 days.

Needs systemic therapy: symptomatic or bulky nodal disease, organ-threatening progression, B symptoms, symptomatic extranodal disease, cytopenias from marrow infiltration or hypersplenism, or accelerating tempo.

No known or suspected transformation to DLBCL or high-grade B-cell lymphoma (prior transformation now relapsed as MZL only is allowed). CNS involvement allowed if not progressing or CNS-directed treatment not needed during the first 8 cycles.
Relapsed/refractory after ≥1 prior CD20-directed systemic therapy; prior antibiotics or radiation for localized MZL allowed and do not count as a line.
Prior BTK inhibitor or CD3/CD20 bispecific allowed only if completed ≥180 days before registration with best response PR or CR. No prior polatuzumab vedotin.
No CAR-T within 28 days, autologous SCT within 100 days, or allogeneic SCT within 180 days; no active GVHD needing ≥10 mg prednisone; no active PTLD.

No systemic corticosteroids ≥10 mg prednisone equivalent or other immunosuppressants within 7 days (replacement or short-term premedication allowed). Strong/moderate CYP3A4 inducers stopped 14 days or 5 half-lives before registration. Prior-therapy toxicity recovered to <grade 2 (except alopecia, lymphopenia).

Labs within 28 days: ANC ≥1.0 x 10^3/uL (≥0.5 with marrow involvement or Duffy-null), platelets ≥75 x 10^3/uL (≥50 with marrow or splenic involvement), total bilirubin <1.5x ULN (≤5x with Gilbert's), AST/ALT ≤3x ULN, creatinine clearance ≥30 mL/min, INR <2x ULN.
No warfarin or other vitamin K antagonist within 7 days; no severe bleeding disorder or spontaneous bleeding needing intervention; no stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 180 days.
No history of PML; no uncontrolled AIHA or ITP; no uncontrolled intercurrent illness (infection, autoimmune disease, arrhythmia, angina, neuropathy, hypertension, malabsorption).
NYHA class 2B or better if cardiac history or prior cardiotoxic therapy.

HIV allowed with effective ART and undetectable viral load within 180 days; chronic HBV allowed with undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy (HBcAb-positive patients need antiviral prophylaxis); HCV must be cured or have undetectable viral load on treatment.
No live or attenuated vaccine within 28 days. No severe allergy to compounds similar to the study agents.
No prior or concurrent malignancy that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant and not nursing.

Cohort A: Age ≥1 (no upper limit); Zubrod/ECOG 0-2 or Lansky/Karnofsky 50-100. Adults may have had 1-3 cycles of induction/consolidation; children must enroll after induction.

pretreatment.note: Sub-study participants must complete it before the cycle 1 ICI visit; missing it removes the participant.

pretreatment.item: Medical record data forms

during.window: Every 30 days from baseline survey, months 1-11
during.note: Emailed automatically.

during.window: Months 6 and 12

during.item: Medical record data forms (PFS, OS, treatment discontinuation for toxicity, select labs)
during.window: Months 3, 6, 9, and 12, or more often as needed

during.item: Sub-study blood draws and past-week cannabis survey
during.window: Before and 10 minutes before end of first ICI infusion; 10 minutes before end of third ICI infusion
during.note: Select sites only.

followup.window: At month 12 completion or early termination
followup.note: Participation about 52 weeks.
